features.offensive_drives_per_game: exact admitted offensive drive rows divided by unique exact admitted drive games
features.offensive_plays_per_game: exact admitted offensive play rows divided by unique exact admitted play games
features.observed_plays_per_drive_mean: mean admitted source_play_rows over offensive drives
features.regulation_drive_span_seconds_mean: mean absolute elapsed-game-clock difference between recorded first and last play endpoints for drives wholly in regulation with valid clocks
features.regulation_drive_span_seconds_median: median of the same eligible observed drive-span population
features.regulation_drive_span_eligible_rate: eligible regulation drive-span rows divided by exact offensive drives
features.source_endpoint_reverse_rate: fraction of eligible regulation drives whose source first/last ordering runs backward in elapsed game clock
features.overtime_drive_rate: drive rows with either endpoint after regulation divided by exact offensive drives
features.rule_era_transfer_mismatch: true when a pre-2023 source-only profile is attached to a 2023-or-later target

unsupported_fields.true_possession_time: not derivable from first/last recorded play clocks
unsupported_fields.full_drive_duration: the interval after the final recorded play until possession transfer is absent
unsupported_fields.score_state_adjusted_pace: not predeclared or validated in this unit

negative_findings: The exact admitted drive sources contain complete endpoint fields but source first/last order is not consistently chronological; observed spans therefore normalize endpoint order and report the reverse-order rate.
Observed first-to-last recorded-play span is not true possession time or full drive duration.
The eligible source population ends in 2022, so every 2023-2025 target carries an explicit clock-rule-era transfer mismatch.
The profile is static for 2023-2025 because no later play/drive capture has an eligible historical publication time.
This candidate unit does not select a production pace formula or authorize protected training, protected evaluation, champion promotion, or scientific claims.
